```{r loading packages}
library(tidyverse) #most things pipey
library(vegan) #pcoa plots
library(purrr)
library(broom)
library(dplyr) #most things pipey
library(rstatix) #dunns
library(lme4)
```

#TEST SET 1: testing additives against NHL control substrate through time
```{r reading in data}
setwd("/Users/enixon96/Desktop/SKELLY_REMcodes")
skelly_EDS <- read.csv("Data_EDS.csv")%>%
  mutate(timepoint = case_when(time.point == "1 week" ~ "1w",
                               time.point == "1 month" ~ "1mo",
                               time.point == "6 months" ~ "6mo",
                               TRUE ~ time.point),
         .keep = "unused")%>%
  filter(species == "Cnat" & substrate.type != "Ceramic")

skelly_EDSlog <- skelly_EDS%>%
  mutate(MgLog = log(Mg, base = 10),
         SrLog = log(Sr, base= 10),
         SiLog = log(Si+1, base = 10))
```

ok so this df is not set up how i would typically set up a df but i think it will work. basically, as i understand it, each row is a sample and we have substrate type and then the ion values for mg, sr, and si.

#MG
```{r mg analysis}

#mg ions

#checking for normality
qq <- car::qqPlot(skelly_EDSlog$Mg, ylab = "sum", xlab = "normal quant")
qq <- car::qqPlot(skelly_EDSlog$MgLog, ylab = "sum", xlab = "normal quant")

plotTimeSub <- ggplot(skelly_EDSlog, aes(x=timepoint, y=Mg, color = substrate.type)) +
  geom_boxplot() +
  geom_jitter(width=0.05)
plotTimeSub

plotSub <- ggplot(skelly_EDSlog, aes(x=timepoint, y=Mg)) +
  geom_boxplot() +
  geom_jitter(width=0.1)
plotSub

#seems like there might be some substrate effects, so lets compare models

cnatEDSmg_add <- aov(MgLog ~ timepoint + substrate.type,
           data = skelly_EDSlog)
summary(cnatEDSmg_add)

cnatEDSmg_int <- aov(log(Mg) ~ timepoint * substrate.type,
           data = skelly_EDSlog)
summary(cnatEDSmg_int)
```

```{r dunnetts substrate type diffs }
#post hoc 1

#dunnets - sectioned by timepoint substrate type
emm_substrate <- emmeans(
  cnatEDSmg_int,
  ~ substrate.type | timepoint 
)

dunnett_substrate <- contrast(
  emm_substrate ,
  method = "dunnett",
  ref = "NHL", 
  adjust = "dunnett"
)

summary(dunnett_substrate)

#posthoc 2

#dunnets - avg by timepoint substrate type
emm_substrate <- emmeans(
  cnatEDSmg_int,
  ~ substrate.type 
)

dunnett_substrate <- contrast(
  emm_substrate ,
  method = "dunnett",
  ref = "NHL", 
  adjust = "dunnett"
)

summary(dunnett_substrate)
```

```{r tukey - age diffs}
#tukey - age diffs
emmeans(
  cnatEDSmg_add,
  pairwise ~ timepoint,
  adjust = "BH"
)

```

#TEST SET 2: testing ion ratio values at 6mo vs ceramic (ceramic only sampled at 6mo)
```{r reading in data}
setwd("/Users/enixon96/Desktop/SKELLY_REMcodes")

skelly_EDSceramic <- read.csv("Data_EDS_ceramic.csv")%>%
  mutate(timepoint = case_when(time.point == "1 week" ~ "1w",
                               time.point == "1 month" ~ "1mo",
                               time.point == "6 months" ~ "6mo",
                               TRUE ~ time.point),
         .keep = "unused")

skelly_EDSceramicLog <- skelly_EDSceramic%>%
  filter(timepoint == "6mo")%>%
   mutate(MgLog = log(Mg, base = 10),
         SrLog = log(Sr, base= 10),
         SiLog = log(Si+1, base = 10))
  

```

#TEST SET 3: porosity
```{r reading in data}
setwd("/Users/enixon96/Desktop/SKELLY_REMcodes")

skelly_porosity <- read.csv("Data_Porosity new.csv")%>%
  mutate(timepoint = case_when(time.point == "6 months" ~ "6mo",
                               TRUE ~ time.point),
         .keep = "unused")%>%
  filter(species == "Cnat" & timepoint == "6mo")%>%
  #removing NHL-Mg bc only data for 1 sample
  filter(substrate.type != "NHL-Mg")


skelly_porosityLog <- skelly_porosity%>%
  mutate(porosityLog = log(porosity, base = 10),
         coreLog = log(core, base= 10),
         interfaceLog = log(interface, base = 10))

```

#porosity
```{r porosity analysis}

#porosity

#checking for normality
qq <- car::qqPlot(skelly_porosityLog$porosity, ylab = "sum", xlab = "normal quant")
qq <- car::qqPlot(skelly_porosityLog$porosityLog, ylab = "sum", xlab = "normal quant")

plotTimeSub <- ggplot(skelly_porosityLog, aes(x=timepoint, y=porosity, color = substrate.type)) +
  geom_boxplot() +
  geom_jitter(width=0.05)
plotTimeSub

#seems like there might be some substrate effects, so lets compare models

cnatPorosity <- aov(porosityLog ~ substrate.type,
           data = skelly_porosityLog)
summary(cnatPorosity)

```
```{r dunnetts substrate type diffs }


#dunnets - substrate type
emm_substrate <- emmeans(
  cnatPorosity,
  ~ substrate.type 
)

dunnett_substrate <- contrast(
  emm_substrate ,
  method = "dunnett",
  ref = "Ceramic", 
  adjust = "dunnett"
)

summary(dunnett_substrate)
```
```{r tukey - substrate type diffs}
#tukey - age diffs
emmeans(
  cnatPorosity,
  pairwise ~ substrate.type,
  adjust = "BH"
)

```
